title: HUMANLLM: Benchmarking and Reinforcing LLM Anthropomorphism via Human Cognitive Patterns

bias_targets.methodology: Checklist-based evaluation using an LLM judge (GPT-5-mini) to assess whether models successfully exhibit assigned human cognitive biases and heuristics (e.g., ultimate attribution error, social comparison bias, egocentric bias) in generated multi-turn role-playing dialogues.
